A long-range multiple hit area attack that inflicts a SPD debuff.
Damage dealt will change based on the enemies' HP.
This will deal a fixed percentage of damage and will not increase due to a critical hit.
After that, a long-range attack with a Knockback effect.
Become temporarily invincible after use.
